findings.detail: Fifty-two earlier-period schedule facts were retained as March 31, 2026 holdings; the cited API Holdings comparative row differs from the current-period extracted position.

rationale: PP03 identifies 52 rows whose source period predates the 2026-03-31 report date. Raw source table 44 row 8 shows the earlier comparative API Holdings III Corp. position at fair value 170, whereas the current-period holdings evidence carries API Holdings III Corp. at fair value 0. The period-specific value disagreement confirms that the earlier schedule row is not a valid current-period position and should have been filtered.
